name: Determining the Smallest of the Three Integers
description: Construct a program that determines the smallest of the three integer values entered by the user.

comments.content: We need to read and process the values that the user enters. To read the input values from the user, we need to define a Scanner object.

We can create a Scanner object using the operator new, as shown in this statement. The System.in object represents the standard input stream, which by default is the keyboard. It tells the java compiler that the input will be provided through keyboard.
We prompt the user to enter three integers.

We need to read the integers that the user enters. We read the input values by calling the nextInt() method because each input is an integer. Note that the user could separate the integers by a space character or enter one integer per line. Since the input consists of three integers, each call to the nextInt() method would return the next integer that the user has entered.
Note that if the user provides non-integer numbers, an exception will be thrown because the input type is inconsistent with the expected data type, i.e., int.
We close the scanner as we do not want to process any input from the user in the rest of the program.
We define variable min to store the minimum of the three integers.

We find the minimum by finding the smallest of the first two integers and then comparing the smallest value with the third integer. Here, we perform the first test (finding smallest of the first two integers) by comparing num1 and num2.
If num1 is the smallest, then the body of this if statement gets executed. Otherwise, the body of this if statement is skipped.
When num1 is the smallest of num1 and num2, we need to compare num1 (smallest of the first two integers) with the third integer.
If num1 (smallest of the first two integers) is also smaller than num3, then the body of this if statement gets executed and num1 is the minimum. Otherwise, the body of this if statement is skipped.
When num1 (smallest of the first two numbers) is also smaller than the third number, num1 is the minimum of the three integers and we assign it to variable min.
When num1 (smallest of the first two integers) is not smaller than num3, then we could conclude that num3 is the minimum

The statement inside the body of this else statement gets executed when the if condition is false, i.e., when num1 (smallest of the first two integers) is not smaller than num3. Otherwise, the body of this else statement is skipped.
When num3 is smaller than num1 (smallest of the first two integers), num3 is the minimum of the three integers and we assign it to variable min.
We need an else statement to process the case that num1 is the not the smallest of the first two integers.
The statement inside the body of this else statement gets executed when num2 is the smallest of the first two integers. Otherwise, the body of this else statement is skipped.
When num2 is the smallest of num1 and num2, we need to compare num2 (smallest of the first two integers) with the third integer that is num3.

If num2 (smallest of the first two integers) is also smaller than num3, then the body of this if statement gets executed and we could conclude that num2 is the minimum. Otherwise, the body of this if statement is skipped.
When num2 (smallest of the first two numbers) is also smaller than the third number, then we could conclude that num2 is the minimum of the three integers and we assign it to variable min.
When num2 (smallest of the first two integers) is not smaller than num3, then we could conclude that num3 is the minimum.
The statement inside the body of this else statement gets executed when num3 is the smallest integer. Otherwise, the body of this else statement is skipped.
When num3 is smaller than num2 (smallest of the first two integers), then we could conclude that num3 is the minimum and we assign it to variable min.
This statement prints to the default standard output stream the text "Minimum value: ", and the value of variable min. The printed text is followed by the end-of-line character at the end.
The expression in the argument of the println method returns a string that is obtained by concatenating the given string and value of the variable.
